recap: People : a pupil / a student ; a teacher ; the headteacher. Places : the school ; the cafeteria ; the classroom ; the playground.

School supplies : a ruler, a sharpener, scissors, a pen, coloured pencils, a highlighter, a pencil case, a schoolbag, a calculator, a glue stick, a rubber / an eraser, an exercise book, a book, a schedule. Dans les traductions de mots isolés, l’article peut être omis.
Au singulier : There is a pen. Au pluriel : There are three pens. Questions : Is there a pen? Are there three pens? Scissors et coloured pencils sont pluriels.
À l’impératif : base verbale + complément. Take your exercise book. Open your book. Use a highlighter.
